<div class="drug-info-card">
<strong>Drug Information</strong>
<ul>
<li><strong>Original indication</strong>: Myclausen is indicated in combination with ciclosporin and corticosteroids for the prophylaxis of acute transplant rejection in patients receiving allogeneic renal, cardiac or hepatic transplants.</li>
<li><strong>Evidence level</strong>: L5</li>
<li><strong>Predicted indications (20)</strong>:<ul>
<li>HIV infectious disease (99.9%)</li>
